shaders.description: How 'use gpu' shaders are built. 'plugin' (default): the esbuild plugin through the community custom-esbuild builders; the build, serve and test targets move to those builders. 'prebuild' (experimental): this package's wrapper builders run the typegpu-shaders tool before Angular's own builders; the build, serve and test targets (and an existing extract-i18n target) move to the wrapper builders, dependencies, a tsconfig '@shaders/*' path and a .gitignore line are added, no npm script is changed.

project.description: The application to configure. Required when the workspace has several applications.
